status: exploratory: added on 14 Nov 2026 after the first v2 validation result, not part of docs/V2_PROTOCOL.md
model: TorchXRayVision DenseNet-121, weights 'densenet121-res224-chex' (trained on CheXpert, Stanford Hospital; no NIH or RSNA X-ray)
input: stored 256 px picture resized to 224 px, values scaled to -1024..1024, no fine-tuning

rows.xray_pretrained_as_is: the network's own output for 'Lung Opacity', used as published (it never saw one of our X-rays)
rows.xray_pretrained_frozen: logistic regression on the network's 1,024 features, trained on the adult training X-rays; C = 0.001 chosen on adult validation X-rays

validation.note: validation X-rays only; test results come from scripts/10_v2_report.py
